metadata.description: Supertab's private Claude Code plugin marketplace. Contains keeptabs and its rewrite keeptabs-mod.

plugins.name: keeptabs
plugins.description: Shows what Claude Code is spending, stops it at limits you set, and gives the agent the numbers it needs to stay inside a budget.

plugins.name: keeptabs-mod
plugins.description: keeptabs rewritten around a Claude Code hooks module (2.1.287 or later): every API call in a ledger from the first prompt, no telemetry setup. Install this or keeptabs, not both.
